newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SHARES IN CZECH SPT SEEN FALLING WITH MKT.
newsitem.headline: SHARES IN CZECH SPT SEEN FALLING WITH MKT.

text.p: Shares in Czech SPT Telecom a.s. again fell sharply on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday with dealers predicting further declines as bearish sentiment, particularly from abroad, continues to hit Czech equities.
SPT closed down 54 crowns, 1.5 percent, to 3,440 on the PX50 index putting the issue 10.6 percent below its price of one month ago.
"I think the whole market can go more down and also SPT," sad Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
SPT is the most heavily weighted Czech share accounting for over 20 percent of the PX50 index's capitalisation and often exerting a decisive influence on the direction of the market.

It posted powerful gains in the first weeks of trading this year and outperformed the PX50 as a whole. But since the current bear run began, led by foreign inverstor concerns about Czech macroecnomic fundmentals, that trend has been reversed.
In the last month SPT has fallen 10.6 percent compared with 7.5 percent for the PX50 index.

"Fundamentally, I don't see anything new just lower interest in the market...when the market was at the top a few weeks ago Telecom was one of the most expensive and lots of people expected the price to go lower," said Kusacek.
